merchant/31424.htm.text: Amulet Seller Shantra: Tejakar Pa'agrio! The fire welcomes you, dear brother! You look like you could use some time off of your feet! You know, of course, that a true understanding of fire is essential for success in this world. This amulet should suit you perfectly!
